# Mixcloud
> Mixcloud is an audio streaming platform for discovering, uploading, and listening to DJ mixes, radio shows, and podcasts.

Mixcloud serves listeners, DJs, radio stations, and creators with long-form audio hosting, music discovery, charts, subscriptions, and creator monetization tools.

## Core Platform
- [Mixcloud Home](https://www.mixcloud.com/): Main entry point for discovering featured mixes, shows, and creators.
- [Explore](https://www.mixcloud.com/discover/): Browse music and spoken-word content across genres, moods, and communities.
- [Charts](https://www.mixcloud.com/charts/): View trending shows and mixes ranked across categories and time periods.
- [Live](https://www.mixcloud.com/live/): Access Mixcloud Live streams from DJs, radio stations, and creators.
- [Categories](https://www.mixcloud.com/categories/): Browse platform content by broad audio and music categories.
- [Search](https://www.mixcloud.com/search/): Find creators, shows, tracks, and playlists across the platform.

## Genres & Discovery
- [Genres](https://genres.mixcloud.com/): Explore Mixcloud’s genre taxonomy and community listening trends.
- [More Genres](https://genres.mixcloud.com/more-genres): Browse additional genre pages beyond the primary discovery categories.
- [Electronic](https://www.mixcloud.com/discover/electronic/): Discover electronic mixes, DJ sets, and radio shows.
- [Hip Hop](https://www.mixcloud.com/discover/hip-hop/): Find hip hop mixes, rap shows, and related audio programming.
- [Jazz](https://www.mixcloud.com/discover/jazz/): Explore jazz-focused radio shows, selections, and curated sessions.
- [World](https://www.mixcloud.com/discover/world/): Listen to global music programming from diverse regions and scenes.

## For Creators
- [Upload](https://www.mixcloud.com/upload/): Upload new cloudcasts and publish long-form audio content.
- [Creator Subscriptions](https://www.mixcloud.com/select/): Learn about Mixcloud’s fan subscription program for creators.
- [Live Streaming](https://www.mixcloud.com/live/creators/): Information for creators using Mixcloud Live to stream audio.
- [Pro](https://www.mixcloud.com/pro/): Creator plan with advanced tools, branding, and analytics features.
- [Monetization](https://www.mixcloud.com/select/): Enable recurring fan support and subscriber-only content access.
- [Apps for Creators](https://www.mixcloud.com/apps/): Access Mixcloud apps and tools for listening and publishing workflows.

## Listening Apps
- [Apps](https://www.mixcloud.com/apps/): Overview of Mixcloud mobile and connected listening applications.
- [iPhone App](https://www.mixcloud.com/apps/): Listen to shows and mixes on iOS devices.
- [Android App](https://www.mixcloud.com/apps/): Stream and discover Mixcloud content on Android devices.
- [Apple CarPlay](https://www.mixcloud.com/apps/): Use Mixcloud in supported in-car listening environments.
- [Android Auto](https://www.mixcloud.com/apps/): Access Mixcloud playback through compatible Android Auto systems.

## Community & Editorial
- [Blog](https://blog.mixcloud.com/): Official Mixcloud blog with product updates, creator stories, and music culture articles.
- [Community](https://www.mixcloud.com/community/): Community-focused resources, announcements, and creator participation information.
- [Featured](https://www.mixcloud.com/discover/featured/): Editorially highlighted shows, mixes, and creators.
- [Staff Picks](https://www.mixcloud.com/discover/featured/): Curated recommendations from Mixcloud’s editorial team.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://help.mixcloud.com/): Support articles for listeners, creators, billing, and account management.
- [Submit a Request](https://help.mixcloud.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact Mixcloud support for account or technical issues.
- [Copyright Information](https://help.mixcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000093060-Copyright): Guidance on rights, takedowns, and copyright-related policies.
- [Creator Support](https://help.mixcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000092900-For-Creators): Help articles for uploading, live streaming, and creator tools.
- [Listener Support](https://help.mixcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000092880-For-Listeners): Help for playback, subscriptions, apps, and listening features.

## Account & Legal
- [Sign Up](https://www.mixcloud.com/signup/): Create a Mixcloud account for listening or publishing.
- [Log In](https://www.mixcloud.com/login/): Access an existing Mixcloud account.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.mixcloud.com/terms/): Legal terms governing use of the Mixcloud platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mixcloud.com/privacy/): Details on data collection, processing, and privacy practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.mixcloud.com/cookies/): Information about Mixcloud’s use of cookies and tracking technologies.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.mixcloud.com/guidelines/): Rules and expectations for participation on the platform.

## Business
- [About](https://www.mixcloud.com/about/): Overview of Mixcloud’s mission, company, and platform purpose.
- [Careers](https://www.mixcloud.com/careers/): Open roles and information about working at Mixcloud.
- [Press](https://www.mixcloud.com/press/): Press resources and company news for media use.
